questions.query: How do I configure API requests, tool calls, output tokens and timeout in the compact agent workbench UI?
facts: Numeric host controls select request, tool, per-response token and HTTP deadline limits; Start freezes them.
Opening defaults128/256/32768/180; Start freezes grants, no preset/reset buttons.

questions.query: Can I raise Cells beyond4096 for one native edit and also authorize the whole canvas?
facts: Cells is per operation, UI default16384, configurable1–65536; host freezes it and legacy absent grant stays4096.
The native owner separately retains64 consumed-proposal receipts across tasks/generations; UI budgets do not raise it.

questions.query: Where can I read raw agent requests, response errors and native receipts and see active status and token usage?
facts: Separate Traffic window supports raw Content/Event, copy/export and bounded local JSONL/PNG artifacts; headers excluded and configured key redacted.
Dashboard separates HTTP/native/authorization/retirement waits and uses actual provider usage or unknown/partial.

questions.query: How do TPM pacing, rate-limit retries and Match area interact with Stop and the actual edit capacity?
facts: Match area freezes W times H, up to65536 cells; oversized matching blocks Start rather than silently clamping.
TPM is local token pacing, default50000; waiting is cancellable and temporary429 retries are bounded without native replay.

questions.query: Why does preparing990 cells generate38164 bytes and which native audit details should be sent to the model?
facts: Local audit receipts, model-facing selected facts and filtered Conversation are different representations.
The990-cell example is measured legacy overhead; selected-field comparison is not a live-model performance result.

questions.query: How does the desktop provider profile connect to the same Python Runner and native World while preserving Stop and source gates?
facts: Desktop backend operates the existing World via bounded IPC; no MCP or duplicate controller.
Native Stop acknowledgment, frozen permissions and live funding/source checks remain independently enforced.
